brand.note: Benchmark-scoped trusted canonical brand data, not the future persistent brands registry. A migration to that registry must preserve this brand_id.

typography.note: Benchmark role mapping (configuration, not Brand Memory). Brand Memory carries only family + weights. Both fonts are variable: a weight is an instance (wght) of the same hash-checked bytes. No third family and no fallback. A text layer addresses a font by one reference, so each role has its own instance_ref (same resource, same hash-checked bytes, one wght instance).

body.use: body / small informational copy if needed

private_payloads.policy: The repository is public and its asset policy (benchmarks/creative-fidelity/README.md, .gitignore data/private/) forbids committing merchant originals. Only metadata, hash and evidence are committed; the bytes live in the gitignored private location and are verified against this hash on load. CI does not need the file.

owner_declaration.statement: The attached image is a real photograph of a real personalised phone case produced / used by HABB, merchant-provided and approved for HABB CREATIVE BENCHMARK 001 use. It is not an AI-generated product image, not a stock image and not a Canva / mockup render.
owner_declaration.authentication: Owner authorization captured for the benchmark bootstrap / run preparation. Not authenticated by Nordla Identity, which remains an open dependency. The clock was read once, outside any builder.

verified_file_facts.unchanged: The original bytes are the evidence: no crop, enhancement, denoise, relight, rotation, upscale, recompression or colour change. Any production transformation works on a derived copy; this hash always names the original.

visual_observations: phone case viewed from the back
a printed personalised design covers the rear surface
a separate small circular cutout beside the camera module
the printed scene contains a beach / sunset composition and an open book
asset_evidence.not_inferred: The phone model was NOT inferred from the image: camera geometry and visual similarity are never proof. It comes from the owner’s statement and the exact catalogue item (see product_evidence).

must_remain_unchanged.camera_geometry: the camera / cutout geometry (the vertical three-lens module and the separate circular cutout)
must_remain_unchanged.printed_artwork: the printed artwork, as pixels and content
must_remain_unchanged.printed_text: the printed text inside the artwork: it is product content, never rewritten, never OCR-reinterpreted and never promoted to a marketing claim
must_remain_unchanged.border_material: the case border / material appearance: nothing is fabricated

fidelity_baseline.face_gate_note: The photo shows no clearly visible human face. This is a fact about this asset only: the global HABB rule that customer faces must never be altered is unchanged.

bindings_notes: ASSET payload availability: the real photograph is private (not in Git). It is available, and the benchmark RUNNABLE, only where the hash-verified file is present; a clean clone reports ASSET_PAYLOAD_UNAVAILABLE and BLOCKED. This is correct.
RUNNABLE is not RUN: this configuration stays NOT_RUN and C2 stays closed until a real run records its evidence.
